forward_contemporaneous.verdict: Contemporaneous flow IS structured. Across 41 polls of the live slate, two-sidedness rises monotonically with first-differenced shares/minute -- 0%, 0%, 0%, 67%, 100% by quintile -- and only 18 of 60 live markets had any measurable flow at all. This measures the VENUE. Whether it predicts OUR completion is the pre-registered forward test, not a conclusion available from this data.

forward_gate.cohort_rule: admit only markets in the top two flow quintiles AND two_sided true, measured over at least 10 intervals before admission
forward_gate.confound_named_in_advance: the entry-band fix (a9b0b243) landed between the baseline and any forward cohort, so a forward run measures flow selection AND that fix together. Attributing the delta to flow alone requires either a same-period control arm without the flow filter, or accepting the combined claim and saying so.
forward_gate.fail: stranded share at or above 7/31, or fill rate below 23.1%
forward_gate.inconclusive: fewer than 15 markets with a first-side fill
forward_gate.not_a_licence: passing this gate is evidence for a selection rule, not authority to increase size, concurrency or capital.
forward_gate.pass: stranded share strictly below 7/31 AND complete fill rate at or above the FULL cohort's 23.1%, over at least 15 markets with a first-side fill
forward_gate.question: does entering only high-flow, two-sided markets raise our completion rate over the R5F baseline?

labels.descriptive: cohorts are not randomly assigned; no causal claim
labels.forward: first-differenced shares/minute over the live slate; contemporaneous, and about the VENUE, not about our fills
labels.retro: lifetime cumulative volume; the weak measure, reported because it is the only one the venue can serve for a settled market

separable.why: no threshold separates them: the quietest market that completed is quieter than the loudest market that stranded

retro_lifetime.verdict: Lifetime volume does NOT separate the cohorts. Medians are indistinguishable (completed 159,272, stranded 144,559, difficulty 98,471) and the extremes run the wrong way: the quietest market we traded completed in full at 25,034 shares while the loudest stranded one held 511,234. A rule built on headline volume would have kept every market that stranded.
